'''Vit'ash Kolk''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Encounter" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="Date" /> Kolk and her enforcers [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorized]] the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on Hoth and was ultimately [[Death/Legends|stopped]] by an individual.<ref name="Encounter" />
